qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the fuel tank to body screw on all models?
How much torque should be applied to the fuel tank nut on the E30 model?
What is the torque difference between the E30 and E24 fuel tank nuts?
qa_pairs.answer: The E30 requires 25 Nm (ft. lbs.) while the E24 requires 45 Nm (ft. lbs.), both using M8 screws.

qa_pairs.question: What torque specification is required for the retaining strap on the E39?
How much torque is specified for the connecting pipe to fuel tank on the E30?
What is the torque specification for the heat shield to fuel tank on the E30 model?
How does the heat shield torque specification differ between E24 and E31 models?
qa_pairs.answer: The E24 requires 1.0 Nm (ft. lbs.) while the E31 requires 3 Nm (ft. lbs.).
